BackstoryDef.title: rebellious city youth
BackstoryDef.description: Born long after the Great War in a fortified city built inside an old stadium, [PAWN_nameDef] grew up chafing under the arrogant rule of wealthy elites. [PAWN_pronoun] spent [PAWN_possessive] youth running with street outcasts and sticking up for those pushed into the slums.

BackstoryDef.title: anarchist ghoul mayor
BackstoryDef.description: Transformed into a ghoul after taking an experimental radiation drug to escape despair, [PAWN_nameDef] found new purpose rallying drifters, ghouls, and misfits into a free haven. Clad in a stolen colonial frock coat and tricorn hat, [PAWN_pronoun] rules by street justice and fierce loyalty.

BackstoryDef.title: pre-war radio dreamer
BackstoryDef.description: Growing up before the bombs fell, [PAWN_nameDef] spent every evening glued to a crackling vacuum-tube radio listening to pulp crime dramas. [PAWN_pronoun] memorized every dramatic monologue of [PAWN_possessive] favorite masked vigilante hero.

BackstoryDef.title: centuries-old comic idealist
BackstoryDef.description: Having survived two centuries of radiation and bigotry as a gentle ghoul, [PAWN_nameDef] clings to pre-war radio scripts as a beacon of hope in a cynical wasteland. Nervous and soft-hearted, [PAWN_pronoun] sews replica vigilante costumes and broadcasts tales of justice.

BackstoryDef.title: conditioned ghoul foundling
BackstoryDef.description: Raised from youth inside an isolated underground ghoul enclave, [PAWN_nameDef] was subjected to strict psychological conditioning that bound [PAWN_objective] to absolute obedience toward whoever held [PAWN_possessive] contract. [PAWN_pronoun] spoke little and trained relentlessly with heavy shotguns.

BackstoryDef.title: silent giant bodyguard
BackstoryDef.description: Towering over humans and fellow ghouls alike, [PAWN_nameDef] is a stoic, terrifyingly efficient enforcer who lets [PAWN_possessive] combat shotgun do all the talking. Unflinching under heavy fire, [PAWN_pronoun] guards [PAWN_possessive] allies with cold, lethal precision.

BackstoryDef.title: pre-war city tough
BackstoryDef.description: Born in the industrial neighborhoods of a pre-war metropolis, [PAWN_nameDef] learned how to throw a punch and handle a rifle long before the nuclear flash. [PAWN_pronoun] possessed a sharp instinct for sizing up danger and keeping a cool head in a crisis.

BackstoryDef.title: immortal wasteland mercenary
BackstoryDef.description: Mutated by the fallout of 2077, [PAWN_nameDef] has spent over two hundred years working as a trusted scout, bodyguard, and troubleshooter. World-weary yet fiercely dependable, [PAWN_pronoun] combines pre-war grit with centuries of wasteland combat experience.

BackstoryDef.title: pre-war shopkeeper's daughter
BackstoryDef.description: Before the Great War reduced the world to ash, [PAWN_nameDef] helped run a bustling neighborhood general store, balancing ledgers and chatting with regular customers. [PAWN_pronoun] learned early how to spot a fair bargain and stretch scarce supplies.

BackstoryDef.title: bicentennial supply merchant
BackstoryDef.description: Having outlived empires and watched generations of wastelanders come and go, [PAWN_nameDef] runs a thriving supply shop for fellow ghouls and friendly travelers. Sharp-witted and warmly maternal, [PAWN_pronoun] remembers the old world clearly while thriving in the new.

BackstoryDef.title: oppressed saloon apprentice
BackstoryDef.description: Enslaved in a harsh wasteland saloon for much of [PAWN_possessive] youth, [PAWN_nameDef] endured constant cruelty from bigoted humans while scrubbing floors and mixing drinks. In secret, [PAWN_pronoun] patched up wounded travelers and studied scavenged medical manuals.

BackstoryDef.title: compassionate ghoul medic
BackstoryDef.description: Finally free to serve among [PAWN_possessive] own kind, [PAWN_nameDef] tends to the injured and brews restorative tonics with quiet, humble dedication. Despite decades of mistreatment by smoothskins, [PAWN_pronoun] refuses to let bitterness harden [PAWN_possessive] gentle heart.
